summary: A Yes vote continues the city's paramedic services special tax for four years at $107.50 per taxable unit or per 1,000 square feet of nonresidential space, with annual increases up to a maximum of $118.

tax.text: A Yes vote approves a four-year extension and increase of taxes to fund paramedic services.
tax.quote: Eight jurisdictions in central Marin County are asking voters to approve a four-year extension and increase of taxes for paramedic services.

tax.text: A No vote rejects the proposed four-year tax extension and increase.
